en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a cobbled urban street with multi‑story European-style buildings, shopfronts with awnings, and a horse‑drawn carriage moving along the road. Leafless trees line the right side. The street scene is labeled "Strada Domneasca" beneath the image. In the upper right appears the printed word "Galatz." There is a round postal/collector mark at lower left and handwritten text and date at the bottom.
